name: OpenKumite
tagline: Open-source 3D fighting game engine that plays your converted Tekken 3
description: An open-source fighting game engine written in Rust that plays game data converted from your own Tekken 3 PS1 disc, 1:1 as the original, with local versus and online rollback netplay. It converts the disc itself: start it and choose your disc image on its Game data screen (Tekken 2 and Counter-Strike levels optional). It contains no game data.

labels.hint: Your own PS1 disc image, chosen in OpenKumite's Game data screen

howToPlay.title: Click Install
howToPlay.detail: OpenKumite is downloaded; nothing is built.

howToPlay.title: Choose your Tekken 3 disc in OpenKumite
howToPlay.detail: On its Game data screen, select your Tekken 3 PS1 disc image the first time. It converts the disc itself; Tekken 2 is optional.
